tie_break: one configuration survived S3.0, so there was nothing to break. The grid is 12 cells, 8 fit A5's step budget and 4 do not (k1_o1, k2_o1, k3_o1, k4_o1). Every cell's step, save interval, startup and record are multiples of that cell's tau because the axis cards marked them varies_with trap_stiffness, and the step count is therefore THE SAME AT EVERY STIFFNESS: 6e4 at the middle row, 2e5 at the fast row, 6e6 at the slow row. The sweep is flat in stiffness and steep in offset, and the slow row is what the conservative cost refuses. THIS REVISION'S OPERATING POINT IS ONE KEPT CELL, k3_o2, and not the eight: the per-step cost the budget rests on is a bracket three decades wide, measured at 1000 particles for a configuration that runs one, and planning eight cells on it would plan most of them on a number known to be off. The smoke cell measures it, and the sweep is the next revision's, against the measured rate -- which is also what recovers the slow row. S4 made no lookup, so the librarian is degraded here by construction and the gaps are the goal's

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the SI anchor: the particle in the bottle, measured directly. Sets the drag through Stokes and the soft end of the stiffness sweep through the thermal width

numbers.name: temperature
numbers.note: a parameter of the noise amplitude and realised exactly by the model, not a thermostat setpoint. The room's reading; nothing actuates the sample (kb:sample_temperature_not_actuated)

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water, validity 288 to 298 K and the temperature above is inside it. THE ENTRY SAYS `of order` one mPa s, so this is one significant figure and the precision below says so

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_min
numbers.note: the soft corner, derived from the anchor rather than recalled from any instrument. The thermal width here is 500 nm

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_max
numbers.note: the stiff corner. The thermal width here is about 20 nm

numbers.name: offset_over_sigma_min
numbers.note: the dimensionless sweep variable is the offset in thermal widths, gamma*v/sqrt(k_B*temperature*trap_stiffness), because that and not the speed is what sets the per-frame signal to noise. At 1 the offset is buried in the fluctuation and only averaging recovers it

numbers.name: offset_over_sigma_max
numbers.note: two decades up, where a single frame already shows the offset. The SPEED this becomes depends on the stiffness, so the speed is an A7 interval per corner and not one number here

numbers.name: noise_step_fraction
numbers.note: the rms noise displacement per step as a fraction of the thermal width

numbers.name: drift_step_fraction
numbers.note: the flow's deterministic displacement per step as a fraction of the thermal width

numbers.name: relaxation_times_per_record
numbers.note: the FLOOR on a record in units of gamma/k_t. Below this the mean is not a stationary average and the standard error expression does not apply, whatever the target accuracy is

numbers.name: target_relative_error
numbers.note: the person's, settled 2026-09-23, and it is a DECISION carrying no grade of its own (5.3.1). It sits in numbers[] only so the record lengths below can name it as an input; the authority is the goal's targets[]

numbers.name: save_interval_fraction
numbers.note: the save interval as a fraction of gamma/k_t at the stiff corner

numbers.name: cost_per_step_upper
numbers.note: 44.9 s of wall clock over 10000 steps on hoomd_backend, and mock_backend gave 43.1 s for the same run. AN UPPER BOUND FOR THIS QUESTION AND NOT THE VALUE: that run carried 1000 particles and this configuration carries ONE, so the real per-step cost is somewhere below it

numbers.name: steps_max_per_point
numbers.note: the share of the local wall clock one sweep point may spend, as a step count. NO `formula`, following axis_a5_budget: the ceiling is a decision the person owns and 5.3 has no source kind for one, so carrying it as a graded input would dress a decision as an estimate. The arithmetic is in the rationale, where a reader can check it and no check re-evaluates it. Against the LOWER cost bound this number is three decades larger, which is the whole uncertainty.

assumptions.statement: The person has not given a speed range. Sweeping the speed directly would confound two things, because the same speed is a large offset in a soft trap and an invisible one in a stiff one. The dimensionless offset in thermal widths is what the statistics depend on, so the sweep is stated in it and A7 turns it into a speed interval at each stiffness. One to a hundred spans buried-in-noise to visible-per-frame.
assumptions.falsifier: a person's speed range replaces both ends; and on the bench the upper end is cut by trap escape, which this purely harmonic model cannot see and A7 records as a limit of the model rather than of the protocol

assumptions.statement: A tenth of the thermal width per step. Kept although it is not independent of the relaxation bound, because the identity that makes it dependent is exact only for the harmonic potential declared here: add anharmonicity and the two separate again.
assumptions.falsifier: a configuration with a non-quadratic trap makes this a distinct bound and this note wrong

assumptions.statement: A tenth of the thermal width of deterministic travel per step keeps the restoring force felt during a step close to the force at its start. This is the bound that decides dt, and it is set by the fast end of the speed sweep rather than by the trap alone.
assumptions.falsifier: a person's narrower speed range raises it in proportion; a scan showing the recovered offset flat at larger drift fractions retires it

assumptions.statement: The relative error target on the recovered stiffness is the person's and was given on 2026-09-23. It is not an estimate this axis made, and the `assumed:` prefix is the nearest source kind for a decision -- 5.3 has no kind for `a person chose this`, which is the same gap the run observable waits on from the other direction.
assumptions.falsifier: the person changes the target, which is a revision and not a correction; and an A5 collision at this target is a reason to raise it rather than evidence that it was wrong

assumptions.statement: A hundred relaxation times is the floor for treating the trapped coordinate as a stationary Ornstein-Uhlenbeck average. It is a convention and it is not the accuracy requirement -- the accuracy requirement is a target the person has not given, which is why this axis returns a floor and a relation rather than a record length.
assumptions.falsifier: a measured autocorrelation on a first run replaces the factor with the record length at which the mean stops drifting

assumptions.statement: A tenth of the relaxation time resolves the autocorrelation whose shape the A2 error model assumes, which is the one thing the run can genuinely check about its own statistics.
assumptions.falsifier: a first run whose measured autocorrelation is flat between a tenth and a half of tau_t loosens it

assumptions.statement: Two hours from envelope/budget.json, chosen by the person on 2026-09-19, over the measured upper cost of 4 ms a step, over the twelve sweep points: 7200 / 0.004 / 12, about 150 thousand steps a point, written to one significant figure. THE UPPER COST IS THE CONSERVATIVE END OF A THREE-DECADE BRACKET -- measured at 1000 particles while this configuration runs one -- so against the lower end the budget is a thousand times larger and the sweep is free. The store holds no cost-per-step entry at all, which is the gap this stands on. AND 5.3 HAS NO SOURCE KIND FOR A DECISION, so the ceiling and the person's target both arrive wearing `assumed:`, which means an estimate; second instance in this one question, raised rather than worked around.
assumptions.falsifier: a smoke run at N=1 replaces the cost bracket with a measured value and this number moves by up to three decades; a store entry for the per-step cost does the same with no run; and 5.3 gaining a source kind for a decision retires the prefix complaint

assumptions.statement: Ten relaxation times of discard. The displaced mean approaches its steady value as exp(-t*k_t/gamma) with no other slow mode in this model, so the residual is set purely by the multiple chosen.
assumptions.falsifier: a first run whose running mean is still drifting after ten relaxation times falsifies the single-exponential premise and therefore the model, not just the multiple

kb_refs.claim: The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator. It is a reading and not a setpoint, and it is the room's rather than the sample's.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.
